title: Read a setting
summary: A KEY=VALUE configuration file: print the value of one key.
hints: Read the file with `fgets`, drop the `'\n'`, and for each line compare the start with `strncmp(line, key, klen)`; then `line[klen]` must be `'='`.
The value is everything after the first `=`, so `line + klen + 1` (it can contain more `=` signs or be empty).
